items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: I knew of him. I didn't know him personally.

ctx.x: quartet with me and went down there. And we played in concert, and on the concert -- the fair -- with Marian Anderson, and we had, you know, the reception from the Haitian government with Marian Anderson, and we were all there.
Did you ever get to know the great Haitian Fenlan, a great writer?

I knew of him. I didn't know him personally. Yes, I knew of him. He was a great writer. I met a lot of great men there. I met many Senators and Congressmen, and I knew at the time that I went there, Estimee was president, and he was responsible for the world's fair down there. They claimed that he absconded, but like -- oh, they put him in exile, because they said that he got so much money. Well, this happens in everything. But anyway, under him was Paul E.
